correctness.rationale: The determinant identity is exact: after writing \(\chi_1=\chi_0\psi\), the determinant on \(\{x,y\}\) has a nonzero prefactor times \(\psi(y-x)-1\). The annihilator size is \(|G|/o(d)\), with \(o(d)\ge p\), and the shared-identity union bound is strict for at most \(p\) annihilators. For \(\mathbb Z_p^2\), the \(p+1\) distinct annihilator lines exhaust the dual. The checker independently enumerates representative small groups and sharp examples.
